summary: Auth compatibility with installs of the earlier library entry (Greptile PR #2450 round 2 P1; Codex novel1219-r6): env fallbacks CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_API_KEY (legacy names print one deprecation line). Saved legacy bearer_auth / api_key keys are read in place through the normal sources, order and trust rules: the config file inside parseConfigData (an untrusted file's credentials are still dropped), then the explicit profile's credentials file (before applyStoredCredentials, as the earlier entry read it first), then the global credentials file after applyStoredCredentials with the global-origin check for an explicit profile. The source that supplied the token is recorded (AuthSource / CredentialSource keep their normal labels). Only that one file is migrated to crm_bearer_auth, and only where an owner-only result can be guaranteed (not Windows, where the key keeps being read in place with a notice): under the credentials-file lock plus the file's own lock, after re-reading the file and comparing it with the bytes the load used (a changed file is left as is), with a fresh O_EXCL owner-only backup <file>.legacy-auth-<nanos>-<pid>.bak and a verified owner-only temp file renamed over the original; every landed file is checked with cliutil.VerifyCredsPerms and its bytes. No secret value is printed.
reason: The 4.34.2 reprint reads only CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and crm_bearer_auth; existing installs that use the earlier env names or saved keys would lose authentication on upgrade.
validated_outcome: TestLegacyAuthEnvPrecedence, TestLegacyAuthConfigMigratesOnceAndIsIdempotent, TestLegacyAuthExplicitProfileGlobalCredentials (matching origin honoured and migrated, mismatched origin refused and untouched, profile legacy key wins over a global credential), TestLegacyAuthWindowsReadsInPlace, TestLegacyAuthLandedFilesAreVerifiedOwnerOnly, TestLegacyAuthFailedRewriteKeepsProvenance, TestLegacyAuthInactiveLegacyConfigNeverSupplies, TestLegacyAuthMigrationRefusesAChangedFile, TestLegacyAuthNeverReusesAnExistingBackup and TestLegacyAuthNeverReadsOrRewritesAnUntrustedFile pass and assert no secret in any notice; the FULL live gate passes with CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and again with only CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH.
